prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Houston for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your needs (single tooth vs. full-arch), budget, insurance and how far you’re willing to travel. Instead of one name, here’s how to find the best implant clinician in Houston and some next steps so you get a great outcome.

Who to look for
- Board-certified oral & maxillofacial surgeons or periodontists for implant placement (they have surgical training).
- Board-certified prosthodontists for complex restorations or full‑mouth implant prostheses (they design the teeth that attach to implants).
- Dentists who offer team care (surgeon + prosthodontist) for complex cases.

How to evaluate candidates
- Credentials: ABOMS (oral surgeons), American Academy of Periodontology, American Board of Prosthodontics, or AAID membership.
- Experience: number of implants placed per year and specific experience with the procedure you need (single implant, All‑on‑4, bone grafts, sinus lifts).
- Technology: cone-beam CT (3D imaging), guided implant surgery, digital planning and CAD/CAM restorations.
- Before/after photos and patient case histories.
- Patient reviews and third‑party ratings (Google, Healthgrades, Yelp) but read specifics, not just star ratings.
- Warranty/guarantees, follow-up care and emergency coverage.
- Communication: they explain risks, alternatives, timeline, and cost clearly.

Questions to ask at a consult
- Are you board-certified? How many of this type of implant case do you do per year?
- Will you be doing the surgery and the restoration, or will another specialist do the restoration?
- Do you use CBCT and digital planning? Can I see similar cases?
- What complications can happen and how do you handle them?
- What is the total estimated cost and payment/financing options? What is included (impression, abutment, crown, follow-ups)?
- Do you offer follow-up care and emergency coverage?

Where to search/review providers
- ABOMS.org (oral surgeons), AAID.com, Academy of Osseointegration, American College of Prosthodontists.
- Local Houston dental society listings.
- Google Maps, Healthgrades, Yelp — then verify credentials on practice websites.

If you want, I can find highly rated implant specialists near you. Tell me:
- your Houston ZIP code
- whether this is a single tooth, several teeth, or full-arch replacement
- any insurance or budget constraints

I’ll then pull together a short list of well-reviewed specialists and clinics and what patients say about them.
